command: python3 scripts/verify_staged.py start; repeated next --count 5; then finish. Exact invocations and compiler argv are in process_record.json and RESULTS.json.
mathematical_claim: An explicit membership-language ZFC theory with eight fixed axioms and full finitely parameterized Separation and Replacement schemas has exact arbitrary-structure semantics and is satisfied by ZFSet. The guarded sentence has a purely internal interpretation in every structure. For the explicit extension KZFC = ZFC + Theta, ZFSet modelhood is equivalent to the previously classified residual existence assertion, with no unproved base-model premise. Basic internal Foundation/Pairing and Separation consequences are proved without external well-foundedness.
input_domain: Arbitrary membership-language structures, syntactic formulas with all finite parameter lists, internally witnessed set graphs and predicates; concrete ZFSet and the inherited external-cardinal classification.
tested_surrogate: Fresh proof elaboration, exhaustive named theorem axiom audit, predecessor source equality, expected rejection controls. Mathematical universal conclusions derive from the proof terms, not from finite enumeration.

bounds.build_strategy: Clean serial targets in hash-pinned resumable batches

pass_means: Every compilation succeeds, every named theorem is audited, axiom dependencies satisfy the standard allowlist, input hashes are unchanged, predecessor theorem sources match, and false proof and placeholder controls are rejected for the expected reasons.
failure_means: No final PASS or claim that all proofs checked. Compiler, audit, integrity or resource failures must be reported separately.
non_claims: No proof or assumption that an uncountable compactness cardinal or a KZFC model exists.
No syntactic proof calculus derivation of the compactness/filter equivalence from ZFC, and no full internally coded residual-constraint classification for every arbitrary ZFC model.
Internal formula interpretation and axiom-semantics equivalences do not identify internal cardinalities, powersets, functions or completeness with external ones.
ZFSet modelhood of explicit ZFC is proved in the ambient Lean type theory, not inside ZFC and not a ZFC proof of its own consistency.
No independence, relative consistency, new large-cardinal strength or first-formalization claim.
